maintenance_led.reason: Sells new pool equipment (pumps, heaters, automation) mostly via dealers; roughly half is replacement, but new builds and upgrades remain significant.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pool dealers, builders and homeowners buying pool equipment; commercial aquatics is small, so government is not main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through product innovation and dealer sales of pumps, filters, heaters and automation, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Pool equipment is sold through dealers; pros can switch brands fairly easily, though Omni automation ecosystem adds some lock-in.

notes: Maintenance_led is borderline: a large share of sales is replacement of existing pool equipment, which may tip it to yes.
